text: Live-check the T3 sign-in now that 0080 is in main: braid t3 login, status, a hold, revoke, logout
context:
0080 is in main and installed; the board service runs it. Your live check (docs/board.md "First sign-in and checking it"):
1. braid t3 login  -> approve "braid board" at Full access in T3.
2. braid t3 status -> signed in, Full access; the board's T3 button (top right) turns green.
3. Hold a scratch braid with a running thread: it stops within ~30 s.
4. In T3 Settings -> Sharing & access, revoke "braid board": the button turns red, one push arrives.
5. braid t3 logout -> the button turns dashed grey.
Tell the PM what works and what doesn't.
